description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of the core.fsmonitor feature in a Git project. It sets up and runs various performance tests related to filesystem monitoring, cache management, and diffing, utilizing external tools like Watchman and custom integration scripts. It includes configuration, setup routines, and a sequence of test executions aimed at measuring Git's performance with different filesystem monitoring configurations.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Starts trace logging if GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE is set, configuring logging directories and files.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Stops trace logging by unsetting the GIT_TRACE2_PERF variable.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of empty files in a directory, used to simulate filesystem changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test step with a description and command sequence.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Configures the environment and Git settings for FSMonitor hook tests, selecting the appropriate integration script.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests, optionally dropping OS caches before execution based on environment variable.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Executes a series of performance tests with various Git status, diff, and add commands under the current FSMonitor configuration.
